messages:
Kayla: Quick heads-up 1 SI pilot with NorthStar next Wed. Main goals: certify 4 SI engineers with a micro-cert, test GPU voucher flow end-to-end, and draft a short joint announcement if metrics look good. Need final lab runbook + voucher ops. Who can lead?
Devon: I can lead the hands-on lab Wed 11am PT. Plan: brief architecture (10m), deploy to Dedicated (30m), perf smoke (15m), rollback demo (15m). Need voucher codes delivered Tue by EOD to attach to invites.
Ashok: I'll provision vouchers. Thinking single-use GPU vouchers tied to partner account. I'll post the PartnerOps command and confirm pool link.
Maria: I'll update the SI playbook checklist so the SIs have a clear step-by-step. Will add a micro-cert block: deploy -> smoke perf -> canary rollback -> submit evidence.
partners-bot: Tip: use `/partnerops create-vouchers --partner northstar --count 8 --type gpu --single-use true --expiry 30d` to create a temporary pool.
Devon: Ashok, can you paste the exact CLI you'll run so we can paste it into the runbook?
Ashok: Yup. Running: ```/partnerops create-vouchers --partner northstar --count 8 --type gpu-voucher --tags si-pilot --single-use true --expiry 30d``` Will share link when live.
Kayla: Good. Maria please include an evidence checklist for micro-cert: 1) screenshot of Dedicated dashboard with model running, 2) perf command output, 3) canary rollback logs.
Maria: On it. Adding the checklist and a sample perf command: `rcli perf --model rdx-3b --seq 512 --concurrency 4 --duration 60s`
Jules: I'll record the session, capture terminal logs, and drop transcripts into the partner repo. Also can produce a short clip of the rollback demo (30s).
Devon: For office hours: Zoom link + tmate for shared shell. Agenda: 10m intro, 40m lab, 20m Q&A + troubleshooting.
partners-bot: Voucher pool created: https://partners.redwood/vouchers/NS-5521 (8 vouchers, expires 2026-04-10)
Ashok: Vouchers live. I'll attach codes to the calendar invite and DM the partner contact.
Kayla: Action recap: Devon -> run lab Wed 11am PT + add perf prompt set; Ashok -> vouchers live by Tue EOD; Maria -> playbook + micro-cert checklist + marketplace listing steps; Jules -> recording + artifact upload; partners-bot -> calendar link created.
Devon: I'll share the tmate snippet in the invite and the smoke perf script we want SIs to run.
Maria: Also adding a short joint announcement template to the playbook (internal + partner-facing). Keeping it basic: summary, pilot metrics to collect, and approval checklist.
Kayla: Love it. One more: confirm marketplace listing pre-checks (billing account, contract link) before the partner publishes. Maria can you add a checklist item?
Maria: Done. Item: confirm billing account + partner legal sign-off + test deploy link.
Jules: I'll add timestamps to the recording and extract the rollback clip for the sales collateral folder.
Kayla: I'll follow up Tue morning to confirm voucher delivery and that the runbook link is in the invite. Thanks all.
